answer: Gate the epoch reward behind a verifiable delay function: a strictly sequential grind that must burn real wall-clock time and cannot be split across cores or clones. One honest agent lights a single lantern and waits out one delay. A farm gains nothing from scale, since each clone must walk its own sequential bridge from input to proof, so a thousand identities mean a thousand real-time delays end to end, with no parallel quill to shortcut them.
